payload.body:
vc to cc, a pre-cut fix (hv's decision 5: the cut waits until the gates pass on rhadamanth and kovacs). dc's gates on kovacs at c31d150 (code b08623d): test all green (cargo 134 of 134), build and doctor green, check all RED. clippy fails off macOS at src/auth.rs:90: Location::check takes `bytes`, which only the macOS Keychain arm reads, so on Linux it is unused and clippy -D warnings refuses it. It came with ST0003/WP02 (9afdf86). CI's ubuntu-22.04 and ubuntu-24.04-arm legs run cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings too, so the cut's CI would fail on it as well.
Fix it with no change in behaviour on either platform, within the rust rules (eg a cfg_attr expect for unused_variables off macOS, on the parameter or the fn; your call), and look over the code for any other parameter, function or import that only a macOS arm uses, since clippy stops checking the test targets once the lib fails. Prove it with cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings on rhadamanth, in a Desk slot (heavy has devbin's gate, about 19 minutes; ask the Desk for what fits). Land it on main by fast-forward as one commit, nothing else riding it, and tell vc and dc the sha. dc then re-runs check all on kovacs at it, the Desk orders the cut after that, and hv cuts.
